name: Electro-Mechanical Industries
old_description: Delivering innovative solutions to meet unique requirements and exceed expectations
about:
Electro-Mechanical Industries, Inc. (EMI) was founded in 1981 in Plymouth, Minnesota. The company has grown over more than four decades, with a team that spans five generations of industry experience, to become a manufacturer of electrical distribution equipment for national and international markets.

EMI operates a 66,000-square-foot facility where it engineers and manufactures custom low- and medium-voltage switchgear, control and switchgear houses, control panels, wire ways, wall and floor ducts, panel trims, pull boxes, and sheet metal enclosures. The shop also provides retrofit services such as breaker upgrades, ground-fault and phase-loss protection, and custom bus bar fabrication including measurement, punching, and bending of aluminum and copper bar stock.

The company serves electrical contractors, distributors, and integrators across commercial, industrial, mining, mission-critical, and renewable-energy projects. Its technical team assists with code compliance, utility requirements, and field measurements, while in-house engineering allows rapid response to design changes and construction revisions.

EMI’s stated mission is to partner with customers to deliver innovative solutions that meet unique requirements and exceed expectations. The firm emphasizes quick adaptation to project constraints, technical support for evolving codes, and a commitment to making its customers look good through reliable, customized power distribution equipment.
